# CANDIDATE: STATUS_MD_UTF8_BOM_AND_KNOWN_BROKEN_GUARD

**Filed:** 2026-09-09  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** quality_gate  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

Ensure STATUS.md meets basic quality standards: no UTF-8 BOM (which can break tools) and exactly one '## Known broken' section (to prevent silent failures in tracking known issues). This guard prevents L07-type silent success failures where STATUS.md appears valid but actually contains hidden formatting issues.

## Mechanism

The test will:
1. Open STATUS.md in binary mode to check for UTF-8 BOM (EF BB BF) at file start
2. Read file as UTF-8 text (stripping BOM if present) and count lines starting with '## Known broken'
3. Assert BOM absent and count == 1
4. Fail test with clear message if either condition violated
